##### Project general facts

Kanyon by Beyond is a contemporary residential development inspired by nature, offering a refined living environment shaped by light, greenery, and modern architectural design. The project features a selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all thoughtfully designed with open layouts and flowing spatial arrangements. Architecturally, the development is defined by soft lines, canyon-style balconies, and integrated vertical gardens, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces while enhancing natural light and ventilation.

Residents benefit from a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and community living. The development includes a grand lobby, a landscaped swimming pool area, dedicated children’s spaces, multifunctional pavilions, and a coworking area with scenic views. Additional facilities such as a rooftop relaxation zone, a modern gym, and a private spa with sauna and steam rooms create a balanced lifestyle environment that combines leisure, productivity, and well-being.

Interiors are finished with a refined palette of natural materials, including warm timber, brushed metal, and textured stone, creating a calm and elegant atmosphere. Kitchens are equipped with premium European appliances and high-quality joinery, ensuring both functionality and style. Thoughtful details such as smart storage solutions, enhanced ventilation, and spa-inspired bathrooms complement floor-to-ceiling windows and open views, while units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their space within a sophisticated design framework.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
